[NMET.4.7] **The four `ds.intern.*` gauges report a runtime's own table.**
Which strings an engine interns, and how much it holds for them, is the
runtime's mechanism and not the language's, so the values of
`ds.intern.entries`, `ds.intern.bytes`, `ds.intern.pinned_entries` and
`ds.intern.arena_high_water_bytes` are implementation-defined. A runtime
**must** emit each where the table above says, and **may** report any value
that describes its own interning; two conforming runtimes may report different
values for the same program and inputs. A runtime that keeps no such storage
reports `0`.
gap_reason: An implementation-defined value has nothing to compare against. What stays checkable, that each gauge is emitted where NMET.4.1 says, is NMET.4.1's.
